item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 28/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be hot during the day over the coast of Guangdong today. The weather will be relatively humid and visibility will be rather low. A cold front will edge southwards towards the coast of southern China today. There will be a few showers and thunderstorms over the region. The cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas later today. Under the persistent influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be cool with one or two rain patches over the region during the weekend to early next week. With the monsoon being replaced by a relatively dry easterly airstream gradually, the weather will improve over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Temperatures will rise progressively.
